content.title: How to watch the Fab Five Michigan vs. Arizona Final Four alternate broadcast for free
content.text: Former Michigan Fab Five basketball players Chris Webber, from left, Jalen Rose, Michigan head coach Juwan Howard, Jimmy King and Ray Jackson pose pose after an NCAA college basketball game against Ohio State in Ann Arbor, Mich., Monday, Jan. 15, 2024. (AP Photo/Paul Sancya)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Michigan Wolverines will take on the Arizona Wildcats tonight in the Final Four for a spot in the national championship. Michigan basketball’s most iconic stars, “the Fab Five,” will reunite to watch the game for an alternate broadcast. Here’s how fans can tune in: What channel is the Fab Five broadcast on?The alternate broadcast will be available on truTV and HBO Max. What time is the Michigan vs. Arizona game? Michigan vs. Arizona is scheduled to start at 8:49 p.m. ET. How can I stream the alternate broadcast?The Fab Five broadcast will be available through DirecTV Stream and HBO Max. Fab Five Broadcast Streaming OptionsWho are the Fab Five?The “Fab Five” consists of Jalen Rose, Chris Webber, Juwan Howard, Ray Jackson and Jimmy King. They led the Wolverines to the Final Four in 1992 and 1993.
